name: Rubber plant
summary: Glossy, deep green leaves and a calm, upright shape. A forgiving first plant that grows tall with very little fuss.
purchaseNote: Nursery pot included · Decorative pot sold separately
description: Native to South and Southeast Asia, the rubber plant earns its place with thick, polished leaves that catch the light. It tolerates the occasional missed watering and rewards steady, bright conditions with new leaves all year.

careSteps.title: Bright, indirect light
careSteps.description: Happy near a window, out of harsh afternoon sun.

careSteps.title: Water every 10–14 days
careSteps.description: Let the top inch of soil dry out between waterings.

careSteps.title: Well-draining soil
careSteps.description: A standard indoor potting mix works well.

name: Monstera deliciosa
summary: A little tropical drama, without the fuss. Meet the iconic split-leaf beauty that makes any corner feel alive.
purchaseNote: Nursery pot included · Decorative pot sold separately
description: Native to the tropical forests of Central America, this climbing aroid develops beautiful leaf splits as it matures. Give it room, gentle light and a moss pole, and watch a living sculpture unfold.

careSteps.title: Bright, indirect light
careSteps.description: A few feet from a sunny window is just right.

careSteps.title: Water every 7–10 days
careSteps.description: Check first: let the top 2 inches of soil dry.

careSteps.title: Airy, well-draining soil
careSteps.description: A chunky potting mix keeps roots happy.

name: Organic potting mix
summary: A light, airy blend that keeps roots breathing and moisture just right for most indoor plants.
description: A peat-free mix of coco coir, bark and perlite. It drains quickly, holds a little moisture and gives young roots the space they need to settle in.

name: Sandstone pot
summary: A warm, textured planter with a soft matte finish that suits any shelf, sill or corner.
description: Shaped from sandstone-textured ceramic, this pot gives plants a grounded, natural home. The drainage hole and saucer keep roots healthy and surfaces dry.

name: Watering ritual set
summary: A small set of tools that turns watering into a calm, mindful routine.
description: A long-spout watering can, a fine mist spray and a soft leaf cloth. Everything you need to water precisely, boost humidity and keep leaves dust-free.

name: White orchid
summary: Delicate white blooms on an arching stem. Elegant, long-lasting and happier on a windowsill than you'd think.
purchaseNote: Nursery pot included · Decorative pot sold separately
description: Phalaenopsis orchids can bloom for months and rebloom year after year. Give them bright light, a weekly drink and a little patience.
goodToKnow: Water at the roots, not the flowers

careSteps.title: Water once a week
careSteps.description: Soak the roots, then let it drain fully.
